Package pt.pa.pathfinding

Class Dijkstra

java.lang.Object
pt.pa.pathfinding.Dijkstra
public class Dijkstra extends Object
Represents a helper class with the only intention of implementing the Dijkstra algorithm to find the optimal path in the transport map.

  • Method Details

    • dijkstra

      public Map<com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop>,org.javatuples.Triplet<com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop>,String,TransportMetrics>> dijkstra(TransportMap transportMap, com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop> originStopVertex, Set<String> usableTransports, CostType preferredCostType)
      Performs Dijkstra's algorithm to find the shortest path from the origin stop vertex to all other vertices in the transport map, considering the given transport modes and cost type. This algorithm computes the minimum transport cost from the origin to every other vertex in the transport map, updating the costs as it explores each vertex.
      Parameters:
      transportMap - The transport map representing the graph. This map contains all vertices and edges.
      originStopVertex - The starting vertex (origin stop) from which the search begins.
      usableTransports - A set of transport modes to consider during the pathfinding process (e.g., bus, tram).
      preferredCostType - The cost type to optimize for (e.g., time, distance, or any custom metric).
      Returns:
      A map of vertices to their corresponding transport metrics representing the shortest path from the origin to each vertex, considering the specified transport modes and cost type. The map holds the vertex as the key and the transport metrics as the value.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - If the transport map or origin vertex is null.
      com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.InvalidVertexException - If the origin or destination is not part of the transportation map graph.

    • reconstructPath

      public List<org.javatuples.Triplet<com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop>,String,TransportMetrics>> reconstructPath(com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop> originStopVertex, com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop> destinationStopVertex, Map<com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop>,org.javatuples.Triplet<com.brunomnsilva.smartgraph.graph.Vertex<Stop>,String,TransportMetrics>> verticesTable) throws PathNotFoundException
      TODO: throw exception if not found and do tests Reconstructs the optimal path from the origin to the destination vertex using the `previousVertices` map that was populated during Dijkstra's algorithm. This method traces the shortest path by following the previous vertex from the destination back to the origin and constructs the full path, including the transport modes and associated metrics.
      Parameters:
      originStopVertex - The starting vertex from which the search begins.
      destinationStopVertex - The destination vertex at the end of the path.
      verticesTable - A map that holds the previous vertex for each vertex, which was populated during Dijkstra's search. This map helps trace the optimal path from the destination to the origin.
      Returns:
      A list of Triplet objects representing the path, each containing: - a stop vertex - the transport mode used to reach that stop - the transport metrics (e.g., time or distance) for that transport mode. The list represents the optimal path from the origin to the destination, including all stops and transport modes.
      Throws:
      PathNotFoundException - If the destination vertex is invalid or not reachable.
